summary: Garena Free Fire mass-account abuse tool with no installer-side harm
details: Package implements a mass account-registration tool targeting Garena Free Fire authentication endpoints (100067.connect.garena.com/api/v2/oauth/guest:register, loginbp.ggblueshark.com/MajorRegister, loginbp.common.ggbluefox.com). It ships a 2000-thread worker pool, an IP-spoofing header generator (FastIPSpoofer), and a WAF-bypass user-agent rotator to auto-create guest accounts and harvest JWT tokens against Garena. There are no install-time or import-time lifecycle hooks, no reads of installer secrets (~/.aws, ~/.ssh, ~/.npmrc, env scraping), no exfiltration to an author-controlled destination, no dropper, and no backdoor. The abuse target is a third-party game platform (Garena/Free Fire), not the developer who installs the package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
